Check the token and show its metadata

Source: R/token.R
jatos_token_info.Rd

Calls GET /admin/token, which any token may use to inspect itself. This is the cheapest way to verify that the host and token of a profile work: a wrong token gives a 401 error, a wrong host a 404 or an HTML page.

Usage

jatos_token_info(conn = jatos_connection())

Arguments

conn

A jatos_connection().

Value

A one-row tibble with token_id, name, username, user_id, created, expires (both POSIXct, UTC; expires is NA for tokens without expiry), expired, active, and roles (list column).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# needs a JATOS server and a stored API token
jatos_token_info()
} # }
